scope: targeted semantic search in already downloaded real source; no Qwen or Full MACE run; no M1-M6 changes
pre_fixed_screening_rules: SR1: A must be a real statement with a legal input on which P+ and P- both return normally; an UnboundLocalError on every attempted input is not a defined-to-defined witness.
SR2: A must assign a value that is read before any later overwrite or return. A binding that is overwritten before any read is not a concrete value-change candidate.
SR3: A masking witness requires P+ and P- to return the same observation on an input where A executed; an exposing witness requires both to return normally and differ.
SR4: A relation candidate B (or an operation set) must be checked by independent statement-line interventions; claims are single-witness unless a finite-domain check is explicitly supplied.
SR5: Candidates are selected from source semantics, never from MACE/Qwen scores, hidden labels, or a target acceptance count.
SR6: Every checked or rejected candidate is recorded with its reason.

search_inputs.note: Code line count was not used as a filter. The 224-function scan is only a candidate generator; final promotion required a named witness and an executable intervention matrix.

accepted.mechanism: The normalizer's value change is preserved for non-case transformations but is re-derived by a later unconditional casefold for ASCII case-only normalization.
accepted.reason_for_acceptance: It is the first candidate in this search satisfying all of: concrete value change; P+/P- normal returns on mask and expose witnesses; an independently verified operation; and original-test survival.

Deleting A can leave hidden unbound at the first visible-frame read; the loop assignments are conditional, so there is no defined-to-defined witness for a first frame that does not set it.
A is inside the nested _unquote_file helper and changes its return value directly; platform branches are mutually exclusive and no downstream operation masks it.

On the branch where B executes, A only supplies None and is overwritten before any concrete use; on the other branch deletion leaves value unbound. This is a binding overwrite, not a value-change mask.
